summary: Excellent PowerShell practices: Set-StrictMode, proper error handling, clear parameter validation, least-privilege permissions, pinned action versions. Documentation is outstanding. Minor concern: task requires formal Pester invocation and act-result.txt artifact; workflow uses manual testing instead. Core code is ship-ready.
